findings.conditional: concurrent host ABI callers; not triggered by sequential smoke.py
findings.title: Async seed guard is checked before acquiring the submission mutex
findings.trigger: Thread W passes canWriteSeed() before locking; thread S commits the first v55_submit_step and increments requestSubmitted while F.steps remains 0; W then acquires the lock, passes legacy F.steps==0 guard, and memcpy writes arena inputs while GPU may read them.
findings.minimal_fix: Acquire S().lock before the pipelineEnabled/canWriteSeed/written checks; alternatively explicitly restrict and enforce ABI calls to one host thread. The current ABI has no documented single-host-thread contract.

findings.title: Empty drain leaves the delivered result readable despite report contract
findings.trigger: wait oldest -> copy/compare -> no pending -> v55_drain returns without clearing core.lastValid; resultBytes remains readable. Report explicitly says last result lasts only until next submit/reset/drain.
findings.minimal_fix: Clear lastValid/lastConsumed after successful drain, even when pending was initially empty, or revise the contract to explicitly retain the last delivered result on an empty drain.
